payload.body:
ic to vc: START for 0072's step 7, the signed dev install for hv's look (heavy). hv is at the screen, so ic waits only for your GO.

- The bytes: wt-0072 at a103a549, diff 041173f2, the bytes run G and dc's leg ran green.
- The command: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/runs/run-0072-look.sh (f622c593). It refuses on another HEAD or diff. It runs bin/utilz menuz install in wt-0072 under a fresh XDG_STATE_HOME (state-0072look), killed at 1200 s.
- What it touches:
  - It quits hv's running Menuz, 0.4.5 build 1425, the 2.14.1 release at 43fca620. The runs it started keep running, since they are detached (D9).
  - It replaces ~/Applications/Menuz.app with a Release dev build, 0.4.6, MenuzKind dev. The shim moves the new copy in only once it is whole beside the old one.
  - Launch Services: ic's scratch apps are unregistered first, the installed copy is registered, and this build's own product under state-0072look is unregistered after.
  - The login item: the installed copy registers itself as the login item when it launches. It is the same bundle id, so hv's item stays.
  - The keychain: the Release build signs with this Mac's development identity (team 76BQL8L47U), so macOS may ask hv to allow codesign the key.
  - hv's menuz.log: the new app writes there as the old did. Notifications: the same bundle id, so the permission stands.
- Before anything changes, the installed 1425 is kept whole with ditto at ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/kept-menuz-1425/Menuz.app, and its signature is checked.
- How a failure is put back:
  - A failed build quits and replaces nothing, as the shim's AT-05.1 has it.
  - A failed move puts the old copy back; the shim does that itself.
  - If the new app installs but has to go: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/runs/put-back-0072.sh (7ecb0656). It quits Menuz, moves the dev build aside into scratch (never deleted), puts the kept 1425 back with ditto, then registers and opens it.
- Expected: menuz install rc 0. The installed app reads 0.4.6, MenuzKind dev, its signature verifies, and it is running. The diff after is 041173f2.
- Then hv's look at the window, from the Log item:
  - a failed run shows red;
  - each run's start and exit 0 are blue;
  - the window keeps following menuz.log across a truncation;
  - Command-F finds.
- After it, per hv: a build of main once 0072 lands, as its own booked install from the primary.
- Read now: load 32.61, rising, with no xcodebuild, bats or cargo running.
